name: Manifest Schema Conformance
description: Validates that the runtime correctly parses and validates an IntelligenceSystem root manifest.

name: Mission Contract Schema Conformance
description: Validates that the runtime parses and validates a valid Mission contract conforming to SPEC-001.

name: Invariant 1: Non-Equivalence of Complete and Verified
description: Ensures agent self-declared finish_execution transitions state to VERIFYING and NEVER directly to VERIFIED.

name: Invariant 2: Evidence-Gated Outcome
description: Ensures mission only transitions to VERIFIED when all required criteria have valid qualifying SATISFIED evidence.

name: Invariant 3: Purpose-Bound Authority Attenuation
description: Ensures actions outside delegation scope or explicitly denied patterns are blocked with PermissionError.

name: Invariant 4: Budget Enforcement
description: Ensures actions exceeding token or currency budget are halted and transition state to NEEDS_INPUT.

name: Lifecycle State Machine Progression
description: Validates valid sequential state progression DRAFT -> READY -> AUTHORIZED -> RUNNING -> VERIFYING -> VERIFIED.

name: OpenTelemetry GenAI Trajectory Event Compliance
description: Validates that every action appends a timestamped, structured trajectory event with OTel semantic attributes.

name: Assurance Tier Compliance (Tier 0 Rejection)
description: Ensures Tier 0 (self-assertion) evidence is rejected as insufficient for high-assurance verified outcome.

name: Recovery Policy Execution
description: Ensures verification failure triggers RECOVERING state and retry loop when retry_limit > 0.

name: Delegation Expiration & Mid-flight Revocation
description: Ensures expired or revoked delegation tokens immediately prevent action execution and transition to REVOKED.

name: Sub-delegation Monotonic Attenuation (Invariant 3)
description: Validates that child delegation tokens cannot exceed parent permissions or maximum delegation depth.

name: Multi-threaded State & Trajectory Concurrency Invariants
description: Ensures concurrent thread execution maintains monotonic trajectory sequencing and exact budget integrity.

name: Minimum Assurance Tier Enforcement
description: Ensures evidence items failing to meet the declared minimum assurance tier (e.g. Tier 2 deterministic) fail verification.
